messages:
Ava (Support): customer hit a 400 when using JSON-mode / function calling with our `summarize_items` tool. they say the model returned invalid args and the runtime rejected it. attaching minimal repro + logs below. can eng look?

Rohit (Eng): can you paste the request_id + the raw response body? also is this only in hosted or dedicated?

Ava (Support): request_id: req_2024_09_ab12cd34, customer on hosted ap-southeast. error from runtime: `Function arguments did not match schema: missing required property \"items\"`. full response body:```
{
  "id": "resp_abc123",
  "type": "function_call",
  "name": "summarize_items",
  "arguments": "{\"user_id\": \"u-842\", \"items\": \"[{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"X12\\\",\\\"qty\\\":1}]\" }"
}
```
so `arguments` is a string (stringified JSON) and inside `items` is a JSON string too. runtime tried to parse and failed schema because `items` was a string not an array.

Jess (ML): this is classic stringified-args drift. model emits JSON as a string sometimes, especially after RLHF fine-tuning when examples include quoted snippets. two options: server-side attempt to parse nested strings (try JSON.parse twice) + a relaxed schema check, or force model to return structured args by tweaking the call format.

Rohit (Eng): agree. short-term: add a tolerant parser that will attempt to parse `arguments` if it's a string, and then coerce `items` if it's still a string by trying JSON.parse. add telemetry event `fn_call_parse_error` with `request_id` and `parse_attempts`. i can open a patch.

Ava (Support): customer is blocked, billing-impacting, they want ETA. can this be hotfixed? :grimacing:

Rohit (Eng): i can put a small runtime guard into the hosted parsing path. estimate 2 hours to code + test + deploy to staging, 1 hour to rollout to hosted with canary. will need a quick feature flag.

Jess (ML): also adding a templated instruction to the model's system prompt to prefer raw JSON objects for function args might reduce recurrence. i'll push a prompt tweak and monitor in next 24h.

Ava (Support): repro steps i used (customer provided):```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{
  "model": "rwd-oss-chat",
  "json_mode": true,
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"summarize these items for order u-842"}],
  "functions": [{"name":"summarize_items","parameters": {"type":"object","properties": {"user_id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}}}},"required":["user_id","items"]}}]
}'
```
and the response matched the body above.

Rohit (Eng): thanks. can you also attach the raw runtime logs around req_2024_09_ab12cd34 (headers/info) and the model output token stream if available? helps to see whether model emitted quotes or we escaped wrongly.

Ava (Support): pasted logs:```
[2024-09-11T14:02:13Z] req=req_2024_09_ab12cd34 route=/v1/generate client=acct_993 status=400 runtime_parse_error=true err="schema mismatch"
[2024-09-11T14:02:13Z] model_output_tokens="{\"user_id\": \"u-842\", \"items\": \"[{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"X12\\\",\\\"qty\\\":1}]\\\" }"
```
logs show model_output_tokens is the quoted string. looks like model produced a JSON string rather than structured JSON.

Jess (ML): ok that confirms model-side. implement parse fallback in runtime but we should also update examples and system prompt. i'll produce a prompt patch and a short eval to measure how often model returns stringified args across top customer workloads.

Rohit (Eng): i created a quick PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/512 (parsing fallback + telemetry). will run unit tests then deploy to staging.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for staging: runtime/parse-fallback (sha: a1b2c3d) — starting CI.

Ava (Support): customer accepted temporary workaround if we can safe-parse their responses server-side. please keep me posted, i'll inform customer it's being triaged and a hotfix is in flight. :pray: 

Rohit (Eng): will monitor `fn_call_parse_error` counts and roll out canary to 10% first. if metrics look good, promote to 100% in 30m.

Jess (ML): follow-up action: add prompt example + eval job. assigned to me.

Ava (Support): ty — closing loop with customer in 15m unless there's a showstopper.
